outcome: human milk fat globule membrane proteome
cohort: Chinese women with different parities, maternal ages, and delivery modes
finding: The composition of human milk fat globule membrane proteins varied depending on maternal parity and mode of delivery, with differences primarily related to immune response.
mod_finding: Women who had cesarean deliveries had higher abundances of proteins related to inflammatory and innate immune response in their breast milk compared to women who had vaginal deliveries.
